english: The arithmetic mean of $40$ observations was computed as $152$. It was later found that one of the observations, a three-digit number with no zero digit, had been recorded with its digits in the reverse order, and that the correct arithmetic mean is $156.95$. The recorded value has hundreds digit $3$ and tens digit $7$. Then the correct value of this observation is ______.
hindi: $40$ प्रेक्षणों का समान्तर माध्य $152$ परिकलित किया गया। बाद में ज्ञात हुआ कि प्रेक्षणों में से एक, जो एक तीन अंकों की संख्या है जिसमें कोई अंक शून्य नहीं है, अपने अंकों के उल्टे क्रम में अंकित किया गया था, तथा सही समान्तर माध्य $156.95$ है। अंकित मान का सैकड़े का अंक $3$ तथा दहाई का अंक $7$ है। तब इस प्रेक्षण का सही मान ______ है।
solution_full: Recorded total $=40\times152=6080$; correct total $=40\times156.95=6278$. The correct observation exceeds the recorded one by $198$.
The recorded value is $\overline{37c}=370+c$ with $1\le c\le9$; reversing the digits gives the correct value $\overline{c73}=100c+73$.
The recorded value was $375$ and the correct value is $573$; check: $573-375=198$.
originality_note: New: the misrecorded observation is a digit reversal, so the error 99(a - c) links the change in the mean to the digits (way 5: correcting a mean and place value). Closest known: 'an observation 165 was copied as 125; find the correct mean'. Different because: neither the wrong nor the correct value is given in full; the digit structure must be decoded from the change in the mean.
stem_review: Read as a student: every observation, class, symbol and condition is introduced before use, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently in Python (exact fractions / sympy), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. The stem gives two digits of the recorded value so that the answer is unique (the change in mean alone gives only a - c = 2). Changed: added the digit data.
key_step: Turning the change in mean into a change in total and writing it as 99(c - 3).
justification: Routine correction plus a place-value equation; no insight. Comparable to the routine L2 statistics anchor 2026-P2-Q12.

concept_use.Arithmetic mean of ungrouped data: Totals 40 x 152 and 40 x 156.95 from the means.
concept_use.Correcting mean and variance after a wro: Correct total - recorded total = correct value - recorded value = 198.

blueprint_concepts: Correcting mean and variance after a wrong or omitted observation
